scripts.dev: concurrently -n proxy,api,host,player,analytics,analytics-ui,flashcard -c white,blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,purple "node scripts/dev-proxy.mjs" "npm run dev -w @quizzquizz/api-server" "npm run dev -w @quizzquizz/host-app" "npm run dev -w @quizzquizz/player-app" "npm run dev -w @quizzquizz/analytics" "npm run dev -w @quizzquizz/analytics-ui" "npm run dev -w @quizzquizz/flashcard-app"
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.docker:build: docker build --build-arg GIT_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) -t quizzquizz:latest .
scripts.docker:build:version: docker build --build-arg GIT_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) -t quizzquizz:$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") -t quizzquizz:latest .
scripts.docker:push: docker build --build-arg GIT_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) -t ciberado/quizzquizz:$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") -t ciberado/quizzquizz:latest . && docker push ciberado/quizzquizz:$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && docker push ciberado/quizzquizz:latest
